bhakti.m: (Hinduism) loving devotion to a deity leading to salvation and nirvana; open to all persons independent of caste or sex.

bhaktis.m: (Hinduism) loving devotion to a deity leading to salvation and nirvana; open to all persons independent of caste or sex.

bhang.m: A preparation of the leaves and flowers of the hemp plant; much used in India.

bhangs.m: A preparation of the leaves and flowers of the hemp plant; much used in India.
